title: Product liftoff — quick stand & ops log
content:
Today goal: finish PRD edits for onboarding v2, lock canary checklist, and clear blockers for infra/legal. Quick stand notes and running to-do (personal) — rough, actionable.

Morning pulse (07:45)
- Skimmed feedback from design review — primary ask: clarify fallback for partial profile data (edge case: SAML users).
- Quick sync w/ Evan (8:15): confirmed catalog API minor version bump ok for hosted customers, but dedicated customers need opt-in flag. Evan will file a small infra ticket (INF-qa-optin).

PRD edits (10:00–11:30)
- Section: "migration path" — added steps: export tokens, soft-redirect to new onboarding flow, fall back to legacy flag for 30 days. Need review from legal on data retention phrasing.
- Added explicit contract for token TTL and revoke path. TODO: ask Security for wording — point to KMS/HSM integration doc.
- Removed overloaded example for multi-tenant default — replaced with two short examples (hosted vs dedicated).
- Pending: finalize acceptance criteria for rollout metrics (page conversion, time-to-first-message, error-rate <0.1% during canary).

Stakeholder follow-ups (action items)
- Design (Sofia): finalize microcopy for SSO error states. Due EOD today. (Slack pinged @sofia 09:05).
- Infra (Evan): confirm canary capacity for first 3 days — Evan to confirm GPU pool reservation by 3/13.
- Legal: review retention language + marketing copy for "we do not store prompts" — Jaya from Legal to review; added to confluence comment.
- Support: prep canned responses for customers during rollout. Phil to draft, link in support-runbook.

Launch checklist (canary stage) — condensed personal checklist
- [ ] Final PRD in Confluence (link above) — status: draft -> need legal copy
- [ ] Merge GH PR frontend#842 (blocking: e2e flake on signup) — note: flaky test reproduced locally; assigned to Rahul
- [ ] Update chartboard alerts: latency p95, error-rate, token-cost spike rule
- [ ] Create canary cohort in telemetry (10% new signups) + tag in analytics
- [ ] Post-mortem template pre-created in confluence
- [ ] RC note + customer-comm template for opt-in dedicated customers

Morning blockers (things I need help with)
- Legal: precise wording for retention — this holds PRD finalization. Slack DM sent to Jaya; if no reply by 1pm, escalate to Sam (head of legal).
- SRE: confirm KV cache warmup window and expected cold-start tail latencies for onboarding sequences >512 tokens. Need numbers to set realistic SLO and set canary threshold.

Afternoon experiments / small decisions (13:00–16:00)
- Quick A/B idea: send a short inline tip during first-run that explains caching benefits — reduces token cost and improves p99 for subsequent messages. Prototype in frontend branch; measure delta in first-week retention if allowed.
- Quantization note: backend can optionally serve quantized model to 2nd-tier dedicated customers — risk: slight quality drift in rare long dialogues. Add to FAQ.

Notes-to-self (rough)
- Keep PRD examples minimal — devs hate long narrative sections. Use bullet acceptance criteria + example API calls.
- Capture the "rollback playbook" as a 1-pager that SRE can run from PagerDuty runbook. (SRE runbook owner: Lina)
- Remember to add SDK snippet showing opt-in flag usage for Dedicated customers.

End-of-day quick wrap (18:15)
- Progress: PRD edits 85% done, design microcopy pending, infra capacity tentatively ok but not confirmed.
- Next immediate: legal reply or escalate; get e2e flake root cause or temporarily quash test to merge PR.
- Tomorrow: schedule 30-min post-merge canary kick-off with SRE + Observability to sweep alerts and dashboards. Draft agenda: 1) smoke tests, 2) traffic slice, 3) rollback criteria, 4) comm plan.

Loose ideas / backlog (capture)
- Automated canary observability: small Lambda that posts daily canary summary to #canaries slack — could save manual check. Put on backlog, prioritize if multiple launches collide.
- Preflight checklist generator: templatize the checklist for future PRDs (minimal fields: SLOs, rollback, comms, legal, support, analytics tag).

Open questions (untagged)
- Do we allow dedicated customers to opt-out of the new onboarding at account level or org level? (impacts migration work)
- What is the estimated cost delta for new flow per 1k users (need infra calc) — ask Evan for quick model.

Quick links (for me)
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROD/Onboarding+Flow+v2
- Jira EPIC: PROD-842
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-io/frontend/pull/842
- Slack thread: #launch-coord (pinned messages)

End log. Leaving this doc as my running personal checklist for launch day tasks — will trim and move canonical items into Confluence once legal sign-off is in.

Notes: keep this in users/ (personal scratch) — not polished; drop into production folder after sign-off.
